newsitem.title: USA: Spot propane gains in Sarnia, slips in Edmonton.
newsitem.headline: Spot propane gains in Sarnia, slips in Edmonton.

text.p: Spot propane prices were mixed in Canada on Thursday from prices late last week, with Sarnia material edging higher amid some continued home-heating demand but Edmonton material easing on slack interest.
Sarnia propane was offered at 39.0 cents a gallon, one cent firmer than last Thursday, players said.
"There's still a little last gasp of demand from home heaters; the winter season is a little longer than usual," one Sarnia trader said.
Edmonton material, however, fell 0.75 cent to between 29.5 and 30.0 cents, traders said.
"Propane is definitely coming down. We're just slipping step by step into the summer doldrums," one Edmonton trader said.
Edmonton field butane remained on offer for about 31.0 cents a gallon, traders said, while Sarnia normal butane held pat at 36.0 cents.
